The CRO’s routing repeats overnight-drive conditions twice per monitoring cycle, while missed deviations are classified by the sponsor’s quality team as the most serious monitoring-failure category. The hotel-buffered routings add about $300 per cycle, so the documented issue is whether that added cost is justified by avoiding a recurring, high-severity quality risk—not whether the spend is above the travel median. Your record does not establish that every hotel stop will prevent an error, but it does document a specific prior failure under the relevant fatigue condition and a lower-cost alternative to repeating it.
